SECRET_KEY.description: Flask session secret. Set a fixed value to keep sessions across restarts.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth2 Client ID (Google Cloud Console -> Credentials).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google OAuth2 Client Secret (Google Cloud Console -> Credentials).

ALLOWED_EMAIL.description: The single Google email allowed to log in (e.g. you@gmail.com).

APP_BASE_URL.description: Public base URL, e.g. https://your-app.zeabur.app. Used to build the OAuth redirect URI.
